sentences.text: The Honourable Sri Justice C.V.Bhaskar Reddy

Writ Petition No.10325 of 2023
O R D E R:
This Writ Petition is being disposed of at the admission stage, with the consent of learned counsel for the respective parties.

02. This Writ Petition is filed seeking the following relief:
"......to issue a writ order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of MANDAMUS to declare the action of the 5th and 6th respondents in laying Road forcibly from the petitioner's agriculture land in Sy.No.56 situated at Lachanayak Thanda Gram Panchayat of Rallagudupally Revenue Village, Mominpet Mandal without his consent is illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional with a consequential direction to the 2nd and 4th respondents to take appropriate action against the 5th and 6th respondent for laying road forcibly from his agriculture land in Sy.No.56,
Lachanayak Thanda Grampanchayat of Rallagudupalli Revenue Village and pass.....".

03. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, learned Government Pleader for Revenue appearing for the respondents Nos.1, 2 and 5, and learned Standing Counsel appearing for the respondents No.3 and 6.

04. Grievance of the petitioner in the present Writ Petition is that the respondents Nos.5 and 6 without following due procedure of law under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 are trying to forcibly lay road over the agricultural land of the petitioner in Sy.No.56 situated at Lachanayak Thanda Gram Panchayat of Rallagudupally Revenue Village, Mominpet Mandal without his consent.

sentences.text: 05. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner contended that there is political influence and that no notice was issued to the petitioner and no enquiry has been conducted to acquire the land of the petitioner.

Therefore, the action of the respondents amounts to violation of Article 300-A of the Constitution of India and therefore prayed this Court to direct the respondents not to take the possession of the petitioner's property without initiating proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 06. Sri R Chandra Shekar Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for the respondents Nos.3 and 6 has submitted that as on the date there is no proposal for laying any road from the petitioner's agricultural land, and in the event of taking any such decision, they will take such action after initiating necessary proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: This Court, having considered the rival submissions made by learned counsel for the respective parties, is of the considered view that since there is no proposal of laying road affecting the property of the petitioner, the writ petition seems to have been filed on an of apprehension.

However, in the event if petitioner's property is required for any public purpose or for the purpose of laying road, the respondents are hereby directed to strictly follow due procedure under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013.
08.

06. Sri R Chandra Shekar Reddy, learned Standing Counsel for the respondents Nos.3 and 6 has submitted that as on the date there is no proposal for laying any road from the petitioner's agricultural land, and in the event of taking any such decision, they will take such action after initiating necessary proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: This Court, having considered the rival submissions made by learned counsel for the respective parties, is of the considered view that since there is no proposal of laying road affecting the property of the petitioner, the writ petition seems to have been filed on an of apprehension.
opennyai_summary.decision:

2013.
08.
With the above observations, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
As a sequel, the miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
